findings.location: sections 4.7 and 6; data-model.md sections 8 and 11; plan.md AD-7 and AD-9
findings.evidence: The manifest envelope includes ContextSnapshotId as tag 13 and hashes it into ManifestFingerprint, while the plan says timestamps do not affect identity and data-model.md reuses the Story 12.1 Scan Context Snapshot. Current ScanContextSnapshot.Capture derives Id by hashing CapturedAt together with Repository, Scan Run, Profiled Revision, and ContentHash at src/dotnet/Vulgata.Core/Entities/ScanContextSnapshot.cs:83-95. Two otherwise identical captures at different instants therefore produce different manifest and pair fingerprints, contradicting timestamp-invariant replay, unchanged-input determinism, and acknowledgement-loss retry. T034/T035/T037 do not define or test a stable replacement identity.
findings.correction_outcome: Regenerate the plan set with an explicit additive stable Scan Context Snapshot identity for prepared manifests that excludes capture time, or exclude the legacy time-derived entity ID from canonical identity and encode stable Repository, Scan Run, Profiled Revision, schema, and content-hash bindings instead. Preserve historical Story 12.1 rows and capture timestamps as audit metadata. Update the canonical envelope, data model, research, replay contract, quickstart, and downstream tasks with capture-time-variance golden and replay tests.

findings.location: T024-T027 and Dependencies and execution order
findings.affected_requirement: FR-016 through FR-018, FR-026 through FR-028, SC-006
findings.evidence: T024/T025 require and implement exact safely parsed XML direct-child byte ranges in Phase 4, but the bounded SafeXmlReader, SafeXmlProjection, XmlEvidenceLocator, and non-evaluating range-index behavior needed to prove those ranges is not tested or implemented until T026/T027 in Phase 5. The dependency section explicitly allows US2 and US3 to proceed in parallel and gives T025 no dependency on T027. T025 therefore cannot honestly reach GREEN for the XML half without duplicating the later parser/range-index ownership, using an unsafe placeholder, or depending on future code.
findings.correction_outcome: Regenerate tasks so Java range work may remain after JDT readiness, while XML range RED/GREEN executes only after the safe XML projection/range index is GREEN. Assign one exact owner for XML raw-range construction and make the File Code Unit split planner consume that closed result through an explicit dependency.

findings.affected_requirement: FR-038 through FR-040, SC-008, Constitution Principle IV
findings.evidence: The plan requires real disposable PostgreSQL proof for pair-wide atomicity, rollback, replay, and concurrent writers. T037 names generic PreparedScanAtomicReplayTests without requiring PostgreSQL, while T041 is limited to migration lifecycle/compatibility. The quickstart invokes FullyQualifiedName~PreparedScanAtomicPostgreSql, but no task owns a test file or required test identity matching that atomic PostgreSQL suite. Under the repository's default SQLite WebApplicationFactory overrides, the current task set can complete without proving the PostgreSQL transaction and concurrency behavior on which SC-008 depends.
findings.correction_outcome: Add or expand an explicitly PostgreSQL-backed task and exact test path for the prepared pair store covering every forced insert boundary, cancellation rollback, stale/concurrent writers, replay, conflict, and zero partial visibility. Align the quickstart filter with the owned test identity and keep migration lifecycle proof separate from store atomicity proof.

findings.evidence: The traceability claim maps SC-001 to broad component tasks and SC-004 to T042, but no executable task requires three complete unchanged paired preparations, reversed Repository and candidate input order, and comparison of every path, audit, hash, range, classification, score, selection, both ordinal domains, proof identity, manifest fingerprint, and pair fingerprint. T042 measures only CodeGraph and JDT-LS sub-bounds. T043 covers selection vectors but does not require measuring complete PreScan under two minutes per Repository. T045 only runs whatever suites exist and cannot supply missing acceptance behavior.
findings.correction_outcome: Add an end-to-end release qualification task, or make T043 explicit, that performs at least three complete preparations including reversed inputs, compares every SC-001 output, and measures the full per-Repository PreScan duration against SC-004 on the documented host. Preserve separate CodeGraph and JDT-LS sub-timings.

findings.affected_requirement: Task testing rule and Constitution Principle IV
findings.evidence: T001 declares RED for a test that records workflow commit, scope hash, prior verdict, and authorization, but names no product behavior or paired production GREEN owner. T044 runs after implementation and declares RED only if a forbidden seam exists; when the accepted boundary is correctly implemented, this negative qualification should pass immediately and is test-only coverage rather than an honest pre-production behavioral RED. These labels conflict with the task file's own rule that RED evidence must precede a production change that makes it GREEN.
findings.correction_outcome: Classify T001 as non-behavioral boundary verification with no RED, or replace it with a requirement-backed behavioral RED and exact GREEN owner. Classify T044 as post-GREEN boundary/security qualification with no expected RED; if it discovers a regression, route that observed failure through a new regression RED/GREEN correction.

summary: REVISE. Fresh read-only combined definition review covered the raw Story 12.2 record, accepted specification/checklist, complete plan set and contracts, all 45 tasks, Constitution, AGENTS.md, Ubiquitous Language, PRD and August dated authorities, Story 12.1 contracts, and current source/test seams. The read-only speckit-analyze prerequisite helper resolved specs/010-durable-scan-foundation from the branch naming convention rather than the dispatch-pinned specs/011-java-xml-prescan-manifest; analysis therefore continued explicitly against feature 011 without mutation. Counts are 43 unique Functional Requirements, nine unique Success Criteria, and 45 sequential unique tasks, with no unresolved placeholders, material terminology drift, Constitution MUST violation, or Story 12.3 scope absorption. The approved architecture remains preserved: Vulgata, CodeGraph @colbymchenry/codegraph@1.5.0, Java 21, and JDT LS jdt-language-server-1.61.0-202608141332 over StreamJsonRpc stdio stay on the Windows host; PostgreSQL 17 is the only required Docker service; CodeGraphContext remains excluded. Five traceable findings prevent acceptance: a High plan-owned capture-time leak into manifest replay identity, High task-owned XML range dependency/ownership ordering, missing explicit PostgreSQL atomic-store qualification, incomplete SC-001/SC-004 end-to-end qualification, and Medium dishonest RED labeling. The earliest plan correction invalidates and requires regeneration of tasks; all findings can then be re-reviewed on a fresh pinned boundary. No file, state, verdict artifact, index, branch, commit, or Git history was changed, and production implementation remains unauthorized.
